child_prompt_recipe.template: Use case: illustration-story. One candidate Our Civic Duty modular child pose sheet: exactly THREE {gender_word}, {age_description}. One row of three FULL BODY figures, LEFT TO RIGHT slim, average, broad body sizes. {action}. All three wear {clothing}. Completely blank featureless faces, bald heads, NO hair, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth or facial details. Fully clothed, neutral ordinary child anatomy. Adult reference is ONLY the three-column layout and drawn contour/cel rendering, NOT adult anatomy or scant clothing. Game painting binds style: clean dark charcoal outlines, muted natural colors, broad SOFT CEL SHADOW SHAPES, selective finer creases, no photographic texture or 3D gloss. Exactly three evenly spaced figures with matching pose and clothing, complete heads, hands and feet inside generous margins, aligned heads and feet, no overlap. GENUINE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: only figures opaque, empty space fully transparent, NO backdrop, shadows behind figures, halo, gradients or glow. Wide sheet, zero text or labels, no logos or extra objects besides the book for reading. Output {name}.png.

age_descriptions.8: children about age eight, larger heads relative to torso than adults, short child limbs, no adult musculature
age_descriptions.14: young teenagers about age fourteen, age-appropriate natural proportions, no adult musculature
age_descriptions.toddler: toddlers about age two, large toddler heads, short arms and legs and soft small-child proportions

clothing_descriptions.base: plain gray short-sleeve T-shirt and gray knee-length shorts, barefoot
clothing_descriptions.casual: muted teal T-shirt, full-length blue jeans and simple low white sneakers
clothing_descriptions.everyday: muted rust pullover hoodie, olive full-length casual trousers and simple low gray sneakers

action_descriptions.standing: standing front facing, arms resting by sides
action_descriptions.waving: standing front facing, ONE hand raised in an open-palm friendly wave, the other arm relaxed at side
action_descriptions.seated-reading: sitting front facing, knees bent naturally, holding an open blank book with BOTH hands, feet visible below; no chair, no furniture

prompts.tv-local-news: Use case: illustration-story. Our Civic Duty candidate TV on-air surface local-news. Straight-on on-air shot of a local news desk in the reference studio, two empty anchor seats behind the desk. Camera is the broadcast camera looking AT the desk, do not show production cameras or the TV hardware. Background blank panel. Empty lower-third banner and station-logo rectangle. Wide 16:9 image fills screen edge to edge. Match supplied illustrated game references: clean dark charcoal contour lines, muted natural colors, broad flat soft cel shading, selective finer interior lines, no photo textures, no 3D realism. ALL lower-thirds, station logos, name plates and display panels must be BLANK SHAPES. Zero letters, numbers, symbols, pseudo-writing, watermarks, brands or people. The game overlays current people and text later. Deliver one complete image, no collage of alternative versions.

prompts.newspaper-weekly: Use case: illustration-story. Our Civic Duty candidate newspaper front-page surface: small-town weekly, compact three-column grid, modest broad masthead block, single small photo box, simple horizontal rules. Use supplied game newspaper on the table as visual reference for off-white newsprint, dark fine rules, crisp illustrated outlines, muted natural tones and simple newspaper structure. A SINGLE complete newspaper front viewed STRAIGHT ON, entire rectangular portrait page visible with small margin, no desk or environment, no folded stack. Masthead, date, headlines, photo boxes and body copy must ALL be plain EMPTY PLACEHOLDER RECTANGLES in very pale gray so the game overlays real words and world images. Absolutely NO letters, numbers, symbols, real or fake text, scribble, line clusters pretending to be type, masthead writing, illustrations inside photo boxes, people, logos or watermarks. Fine dark vertical column rules and horizontal separators are allowed; all story text areas are blank broad rectangles, not rows of tiny type. Match provided game's clean dark outlines, flat soft cel shading, muted newsprint color; no photo texture or 3D gloss. Functional layout source also supplied in news-screen-mockup-sept27.html: restrained newsprint, masthead band, lead article hierarchy and column-separated secondary stories. Generate ONE page of this size class only.

prompts.initial-child-source: Use case: illustration-story. Candidate modular child pose sheet for Our Civic Duty, ONE sheet with exactly THREE boys age about eight, left to right slim, average, broad body sizes. All three standing front facing, arms resting naturally by sides. Base outfit means fully clothed plain gray short-sleeve top and gray knee-length athletic shorts, barefoot. Blank featureless face, bald head, NO hair, NO facial features. Age-appropriate ordinary child anatomy, fully clothed, no adult muscle definition. Use supplied adult sheet ONLY for the three-column layout, proportions alignment and contour/cel rendering; change adults to children of age eight. Use supplied game painting for illustrated style: clean dark outlines, muted natural colors, broad soft cel shadows, no texture, no realism. Three full-body figures from head to feet, same head and foot alignment, equally spaced, no overlap, no cropping, no text or labels, no other objects. Wide sheet and genuine transparent background. Keep consistent pose and outfit across the three sizes. This is boy-8-standing-base.png.
